messages:
Ibrahim: Quick update from overnight smoke: ran AzureWing9b-int5 across 4 priority slices and computed a tiny RapidUnitScore for triage.
Nora: paste the topline pls
Ibrahim: TL;DR then run details. Short: ~60% token cost reduction vs fp16, small avg quality hit, recall regression on stacked-doc QA. Recommend hybrid probe with holdbacks.
Ibrahim: run output:
```
model: AzureWing9b-int5
cost_per_1k_tokens: $0.82
baseline_fp16_cost_per_1k: $2.05
cost_savings_pct: 60.0%
overall_quality_delta: -1.1pp (chat clarity + intent)
stacked_doc_recall_delta: -3.2pp
hallucination_delta_on_recall_slice: +0.4pp
p95_latency_short: 200ms
p95_latency_long_cold: 350ms
kv_cache_miss_rate_long: 17%
RapidUnitScore: 0.79  # weights(cost:0.5,quality:0.4,latency:0.1)
```
Cass: 0.79 is decent for browse/summaries. stacked-doc recall -3.2pp is concerning for legal/GTN. Any safety flags?
Ibrahim: No blocker safety hits on fuzz suite. Faithfulness dips align with recall drop. Hallucination small but non-zero.
Elena: ops note: GPU utilization stable ~0.63. Warmstart + prefix cache in local repro trimmed long p95 by ~60ms. KV miss rate is primary driver.
Nora: product question: can we capture majority of savings while protecting GTN/regulatory slices?
Ibrahim: Proposed plan: create routing flag `azurewing.int5.hybrid` with default split 0.7 for non-critical slices, holdbacks: ["gtn_core","legal_search","billing_verif"], and a 1% GTN probe after priming remediation. Emergency fallback to baseline if holdback slice delta >1.25pp sustained for 12m.
Cass: Add metric thresholds: auto-fallback if RapidUnitScore < 0.72 OR kv_cache_miss_rate_long > 20% OR p95_long_cold increases >60ms over baseline.
Elena: infra will wire the flag and fallback tonight. Name: azure.hybrid.canary.2026-03-23. I'll also add an alert for KV miss rate >18%.
Nora: remediation experiments: (A) anchor-priming, (B) explicit answer scaffolding, (C) warmstart + prefix cache. Run 2k samples each and post diffs.
Ibrahim: micro-eval plan: 200 GTN-critical prompts with human ratings; target <1.0pp gap to consider >5% GTN probe. Also run 150 legal samples with tighter bar.
ci-bot: bench-run completed: 6350012345 -> 6350012300. Artifacts uploaded to /bench/artifacts/6350012345.
Nora: Owners: Ibrahim (priming experiments + scorecard), Elena (routing flag + infra fallback + alerts), Cass (PM comms + micro-eval coordination).
Ibrahim: TL;DR for PMs: int5 reduces token cost ~60% vs fp16, modest avg quality hit (~1.1pp), but stacked-doc recall shows regression. Recommend hybrid rollout with holdbacks + priming + micro-eval before shifting GTN/regulatory traffic.
Cass: I'll loop in product/legal and schedule a short 15m sync. tagging @product for visibility. :eyes:
Ibrahim: will post priming diffs when ready. :thumbsup:
